metrics.caveat: Heuristic finding. Pools are grouped by shared name-prefix tokens; one pool (svrn_bitwise) matches two groups and is counted once, in the larger group it first joins. A shared prefix suggests but does not prove common operation — confirming it requires operator disclosure this source does not carry.

prose.body: This thesis reports against itself on purpose. Several of its own propositions fail the falsifiers written for them before any value was computed, and one source field is recorded as a finding rather than pressed into service as a number. A thesis nobody can argue with is a thesis nobody read; the counter-evidence sits beside the case, not beneath it.

The audit gate ran on every field this thesis touches, not only on the fields already suspected. Each field had to prove itself non-empty, live, and definitionally continuous before any proposition was allowed to stand on it. The failures documented on this page were found by that gate, not hard-coded into it — a further failure would appear here with no code change. That is the difference between an audit and an anecdote.

Facts belong to code and commentary belongs to prose, and the border between them is enforced by a test rather than by discipline. Every figure on every page is computed from raw captured bytes and linked into a hash chain; the prose you are reading carries no numbers at all, because a model-written number would be a claim with no receipt. Take nobody's word for it — including ours.

summary.conclusion: Of 15 propositions: 5 SUPPORTED, 6 UNSUPPORTED, 4 DATA_UNUSABLE. The bull case cannot rest on usage, on float-adjusted valuation, or on decentralisation. It rests on supply discipline (T-03: 2.48% TTM issuance vs 4.39% lifetime), a fee-burn inflection (T-02: 23.28% on three-month sums; 58.04% since the trough month), and a deployment recovery (T-08: 2.26x the trailing-year mean) — against usage at 2.87% of its peak (T-01), no evidence that price tracks the fundamentals this source contains (T-04: r = -0.514 at n = 12 — see the power note in Method; the Intents revenue line is absent from txn_fee), a Nakamoto coefficient of 9 at the consensus threshold (T-09), and operator clustering that may cut that to 5 (T-11, heuristic). Net of burn, issuance is barely dented (T-13: burn offsets 1.95% of gross issuance) and the fee multiple runs at 3,348x annualised fees (T-14).
